note: PRE-FREEZE COUNT CALIBRATION. Signal COUNTS only - no win rate, expectancy, P&L or outcome of any kind was computed for any of these trials.
conclusion: Signal frequency is insensitive to the impulse threshold across the brief's entire suggested region (60-65 signals in 2021). The binding constraints are Stage B (three strictly increasing confirmed peaks) and Stage C (double deterioration), both mandated by the hypothesis and therefore NOT relaxed. The originally reasoned configuration was kept UNCHANGED. theta=0.50 was probed and rejected: it produced FEWER signals and began breaching the 600s extension budget (329 vs 2 EXTENSION_TOO_SLOW), confirming the original theta=0.25 reasoning.
implication: ~26 signals/year in the 09:30-11:30 primary window means the pre-registered 100-trade PASS gate cannot be met in a single validation year. This is disclosed BEFORE validation is run; the gate is NOT changed.

trials.description: impulse 0.75xVU/120s (permissive corner of the brief's region)
FINAL spec: absorption reference distribution session-matched to RTH, window 2000/min 500

defect_found_and_corrected_pre_freeze.defect: The absorption reference distribution was contaminated by pre-open legs. A 500-leg window spans only ~3 hours, so at 09:35 the reference was dominated by 08:00-09:30 legs, which carry far less volume per tick than RTH legs. Almost every RTH leg therefore ranked near the top and the 70th-percentile gate stopped discriminating (20 rejections out of 61,320).
defect_found_and_corrected_pre_freeze.evidence: COUNT diagnostic only - reject-reason tallies. No win rate, expectancy or P&L was computed.
defect_found_and_corrected_pre_freeze.correction: Reference distribution restricted to RTH legs (session-matched); window lengthened to 2000 legs (~2 RTH days) with a 500-observation warm-up. The absorption FORMULA was not changed.
defect_found_and_corrected_pre_freeze.residual_finding: Even after the correction the absorption gate rejects only 26 of 61,348 candidates. This is structural, not a bug: Stage C's efficiency-deterioration test (progress per aggressive contract falling) and Stage D's absorption proxy (aggressive volume per tick of best-price advance) are near-reciprocal measures, so Stage D is largely implied by Stage C. This is REPORTED, not engineered away - the pre-registered ablation (variant B vs C) is exactly the instrument for it.

final_expected_sample.note: The pre-registered 100-trade PASS gate is unreachable in a single validation year. Disclosed before validation; the gate is NOT changed.
